title: CPCB Notification 2022
content: The Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) framework mandates that producers of plastic packaging must recycle at least 50% of their rigid plastic waste by the year 2026.

title: GreenPack Compliance Handbook
content: All monthly plastic declarations must be submitted by the 15th of the following month. Failure to report accurate quantities results in an initial penalty of 5000 INR per day.

title: Plastic Waste Management Rules
content: Multilayer plastic is heavily regulated. Producers must ensure that 100% of procured multilayer plastic is sent to end-of-life disposal facilities, such as cement kilns, if it cannot be recycled.
